name: SchemaGenius AI
author: Jayvin Busa

sections.description:
SchemaGenius AI simplifies adding JSON-LD schema markup to your WordPress site. Generate schemas automatically with AI or paste your own custom markup.

Two Ways to Add Schemas

Option 1: AI Generation
1. Click “Generate with AI” button
2. AI analyzes your content and creates schemas
3. Save and publish

Option 2: Manual Input
1. Copy any schema from Schema.org or other sources
2. Paste it into the editor
3. Save and publish

Key Features

  • AI-Powered Generation – Automatic schema creation using Google Gemini AI
  • Manual Input Support – Paste schemas from any source
  • Automatic Validation – Built-in validator checks schema accuracy
  • Multiple Schemas – Support for @graph format (multiple schemas per page)
  • Universal Compatibility – Works with any WordPress theme and page builder
  • Performance Optimized – Caching and conditional asset loading
  • Free to Use – Core features available at no charge

Supported Schema Types

Works with all common schema types including:

  • Article, BlogPosting, NewsArticle
  • Product, Service, LocalBusiness
  • Recipe, Video, FAQ, HowTo
  • Event, Review, JobPosting
  • Organization, Person
  • And many more from Schema.org

Ideal For

  • Bloggers – Add Article schemas to blog posts
  • E-commerce – Product schemas for online stores
  • Local Businesses – LocalBusiness schemas for better local visibility
  • Content Creators – Recipe, Video, and HowTo schemas
  • Publishers – NewsArticle and organization schemas

How It Works

For AI Generation:

  1. Install plugin
  2. Get API key from Google AI Studio
  3. Click “Generate with AI” on any post
  4. Schema created automatically

For Manual Input:

  1. Install plugin
  2. Copy schema markup from any source
  3. Paste into the schema editor
  4. Validate and save

No coding knowledge required. Simple interface suitable for beginners and experts.

Technical Features

  • Deep validation with detailed error reporting
  • Support for @context and @graph formats
  • Bulk schema generation for multiple posts
  • Caching system for improved performance
  • Clean, well-documented code
  • Follows WordPress coding standards

Google AI Integration

This plugin integrates with Google’s Gemini AI API for automatic schema generation. An API key is required for AI features. Google offers a free tier with generous usage limits. Visit Google AI Studio to obtain your API key.

External Services

This plugin uses Google Gemini API to generate schema markup automatically. This service is optional and only used when you click “Generate with AI”. If you choose to input schema manually, no data is sent to this service.

When using the AI generation feature, the following data is sent to Google:
* Post title and content
* Post excerpt
* Author name
* Published and modified dates
* Categories and tags
* Featured image URL

This service is provided by Google.
Terms of Service: Google Terms of Service
Privacy Policy: Google Privacy Policy

Additional Info

For support, visit the WordPress support forums

Documentation available at plugin settings page.
sections.installation:
1. Upload plugin files to /wp-content/plugins/schemagenius-ai/ or install via WordPress plugin directory
  2. Activate the plugin through the ‘Plugins’ menu
  3. Go to SchemaGenius AI settings to configure
  4. (Optional) Add Google AI API key for automatic generation
  5. Start adding schemas to your posts and pages
sections.faq:
Do I need coding knowledge?

No. You can use AI generation with one click, or copy and paste schemas from anywhere. No coding required.

Is it free to use?

Yes. The plugin itself is free. AI features use Google’s Gemini API which has a free tier with generous limits.

Can I paste schemas from other sources?

Yes. Copy any valid JSON-LD schema from Schema.org, Google documentation, or any other source and paste it in.

Do I need JSON knowledge?

No. Use the AI generation feature, or simply copy-paste schemas. The plugin validates and formats automatically.

Does it work with my theme?

Yes. SchemaGenius AI works with any WordPress theme and page builder including Elementor, Beaver Builder, Divi, and others.

What if I paste invalid schema?

The built-in validator will detect errors and show specific issues to fix. Many errors can be corrected automatically.

Can I add multiple schemas to one page?

Yes. The plugin supports @graph format for combining multiple schemas on a single page.

Will it slow down my site?

No. Schemas are lightweight JSON data. The plugin includes caching and optimized loading to maintain performance.

How do I get an API key?

Visit Google AI Studio, sign in with your Google account, and create an API key.

What are the API usage limits?

Google’s free tier includes generous usage limits. For specific details, check Google AI Studio documentation.
